items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Looks like Peter Holkowski. I don't know if it's him.

ctx.x: You remember who this Alto is there?
This one? I'll tell you who it looks like. Looks like Peter Holkowski. I don't know if it's him. It sure does. Admired me him. That's Harris.
Oh yeah, Joe Harris, the one we interviewed last week.
